Coram : C.T. RAVIKUMAR*, SUDHANSHU DHULIA
Issue for Consideration Whether the High Court was right in setting aside the conviction of the respondents-accused under Section 302, IPC read with Section 34, IPC. Headnotes† Evidence – Dying declaration, allegedly made to a close relative – Reliance upon – When not inter alia relying on the dying declaration allegedly made to the mother of the deceased (PW-8) – Conviction set aside by High Court – Correctness: Held: Oral dying declaration should be of such a nature as to inspire full confidence of the Court in its correctness – Dying
Decision Date : 25-10-2024 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 2129/2014 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
